rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: high street (pilot), Amber spine, arterials - trees in wells on the shop side, palms alternating on Amber (zone 406 -> about 360); this block's trees stand on grass round its car park
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The block's eight builder trees go (a row on the car park's grass island, two among the trash carts and a lot light, two by the front hedges); three come back on their own spots: the two ends of the car park's island (a coral and a palm, as the strip's island ends) and one in the front garden.

trees.why: the west end of the car park's grass island, by the wheel stops: shade for the cars
the east end of the same island, among the bird of paradise and the bougainvillea: a queen palm
the front garden by the low box hedges, 5 m from the building
